about: The rows of Model > Game review > Execution (R-713 to R-715): every death of a player in the games picked, with the checked chances his team missed (a prot, a heal, an interrupt on a spike skill: the kinds that passed on unseen matches), none priced or ranked, written by tools/golden/review.py execution on the engine branch. His marks are in execution_row_marks.json, never here.

groups.reads: The opening. Men: 8 to the stand; its first flag brought up by AoB Derv, handed to 8 Monk, held at the stand for 24 s and capped at 1:47. Crew: 8 to the stand; its first flag brought up by Water Ele and capped at 3:13. Nobody caps for the first 1:47. Men caps first at 1:47; Crew caps over it at 3:13
